work.name: European Central Bank
highlights: Built a factor-based macro forecasting framework using 126 U.S. economic time series (1959–2025), extracting 7 latent factors to produce rolling real-time forecasts for industrial production and CPI inflation, achieving out-of-sample RMSEs of 1.37 and 0.60, respectively

Led the development of Python-based pipelines automating market and credit risk analytics across 100+ European financial institutions, processing 12 million data points and reducing processing time from several days to minutes

Partnered with risk officers to design and implement quantitative frameworks for rating, liquidity and asset-risk monitoring, taking requirements from problem definition to production and supporting ongoing supervisory reporting across European banks

Validated and reconstructed 10,000 weekly equity and FX market observations using Bloomberg data, recovering missing values from daily series and performing valuation consistency checks that increased valid data coverage by 25%

courses: Focus on quantitative methods and financial econometrics
Thesis: Asset Pricing with Machine Learning
Thesis: Dedollarization of the International Monetary System
